scores.tell: Rover body is a soft uniformly lit white blob with a gentle gradient. It has little core shadow and no crisp highlights. Cast shadow on the lunar ground is weak. The look is soft and CG-airbrushed, closer to the too-round lessons.
none. Smooth broad form turn, soft sheen on the leather, and a gentle contact shadow on the rails, matching the grade 5 saddle. The saddle is a real card.
Calculator has a clean broad sheen, a modest core shadow, and soft highlights on the keys. It is slightly glossy and flat on the dark body, but close.
Glossy blue body with crisp edge highlights and bright keys. Shadows are soft and the form turn is clean. It is slightly more plastic than the real cards.
Soft panels with a broad sheen and gentle shadow turns. The shaft highlight is a little uniform, but it fits the real cards.
Flower petals and stones are lit evenly with puffy balloon-like shading and little shadow depth. The base has weak contact shadows. It reads rounder and flatter than the real cards.
Many sharp specular hot spots on the gold coins, gems and chest edges. The scene is busy and glossy, and the shading is texture-heavy. It is an image-model look compared with the smoother real cards.
none. Broad soft highlights, smooth turn on the rounded body, and clean pale earbud shading. It reads as a real card.
Painterly wood grain on the lid with a hard cast shadow on the grass. The lid has little rounded form turn. It is flatter and more texture-y, like the grade 2 lessons.
none. Smooth, soft form turn on the envelope, a gentle sheen, and clean cast shadows. It matches the real cards.
